basis: Expo SDK 57 reference targets React Native 0.86 and React 19.2.3; it lists minimum Node.js 22.13.x.
The official SDK-57 bundledNativeModules.json pins react-native 0.86.3 and react 19.2.3.
The SDK-57 expo package manifest is version 57.0.26 and lists react-native 0.86.3 and react 19.2.3 in its development dependency set.
sdk57CompatibleCandidate.assessment: The snapshot's expo@57.0.26 is current on npm's latest and sdk-57 tags. Its react-native@0.87.1 and react@19.3.0 are registry-latest candidates, but they are not the stable SDK-57 curated pair. Keep mobile on Expo-managed versions; do not inherit the desktop/web React candidate. SDK 58 is on npm's next tag rather than latest and was not selected.

documentedNodeCompatibility.node24Assessment: Node 24 is explicitly listed in Fastify's current v5 LTS schedule and CI OS table; Node 24.21.0 is within the documented supported release line.
